correctness.rationale: For n=2m≥8, the unimodular affine change y_i=x_i on odd coordinates and y_i=1−x_i on even identifies STAB(C_n) with the circular-fence order polytope, in the full lattice. Primitive facet normals form a rooted directed incidence configuration, so independent active ray sets are unimodular. On each face the active comparison edges join only equal coordinate values; any active graphic circuit is either a root-to-root four-edge square through three consecutive pinned coordinates (τ_i, rank 3) or the entire unrooted n-cycle (τ_*, rank n−1). Thus exactly n+1 minimal nonsimplicial cones. The local four-ray lattice semigroup is k[a,b,c,d]/(ad−bc), multiplicity 2, class group Z; the alternating full-cycle relation yields the rank-one m×m determinantal cone with multiplicity binom(2m−2,m−1) and free class group Z. Faces y_i=1 yield Y_i isomorphic to normal-fan STAB(P_(n−3)); their joint intersections exist precisely for cyclically independent centers and are irreducible, whereas the diagonal alternating edge Z meets all even and all odd families at opposite endpoints. The binary-vertex local-trigger criterion allows exactly one smooth fixed point, corroborated independently for n=8,10,12 (47,123,322 vertices). These finite counts do not replace the all-even-n graphic-circuit proof; reduced support and generic transverse types, not all schemes/germs, are proved.
residual_risks: General char arbitrary algebraically closed; no claims of nonreduced singular scheme or local germs at higher-order intersections.
The n=4,6 special cases are excluded from the novelty claim and generic transverse smooth-factor conventions must be retained.

value.rationale: A complete reduced singular-stratification theorem for an infinite, canonical cycle stable-set family is significant geometric information beyond toric-ring normality. It gives an unusual mixed-dimensional singular locus, transverse threefold conifolds plus higher-size Segre determinantal singularities, exact class groups and multiplicities, an independence-complex intersection nerve and a unique smooth fixed point. The obstruction at the circular edge is structurally meaningful.
residual_risks: The theorem is not a statement about every analytic germ, singular subscheme, or odd cycles.

limitations: Even cycles C_(2m), m≥4, projective toric normal fan in full lattice.
Reduced singular support, generic transverse model and intersections only; finite tests n up to 12 not infinity.
Specialized equivalent crown-poset fan literature may remain unindexed.
